property.name: CanDrawSystemToNonLocal
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device supports blits from system-memory textures to non-local video-memory textures.

property.name: CanRenderAfterFlip
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device can queue rendering commands after a page flip.
property.remarks: Applications do not change their behavior if this flag is set; this capability means that the device is relatively fast.

property.name: IsDirect3D9Driver
property.summary: Gets a value indicating if the device supports copying the contents of a source rectangle to a destination rectangle using a texture as the source.

property.name: SupportsDrawPrimitives2
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device can support at least a DirectX 5–compliant driver.

property.name: SupportsDrawPrimitives2Ex
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device can support at least a DirectX 7–compliant driver.

property.name: SupportsDrawPrimitivesTransformedVertex
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device exports a DrawPrimitives-aware hardware abstraction layer (HAL).

property.name: SupportsExecuteSystemMemory
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device can use execute buffers from video memory.

property.name: SupportsExecuteVideoMemory
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device can use execute buffers from video memory.

property.name: SupportsHardwareRasterization
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device has hardware acceleration for scene rasterization.

property.name: SupportsHardwareTransformAndLight
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device can support transformation and lighting in hardware.

property.name: SupportsSeparateTextureMemories
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device is texturing from separate memory pools.

property.name: SupportsStreamOffset
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device supports stream offsets.

property.name: SupportsTextureNonLocalVideoMemory
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device can retrieve textures from non-local video memory.

property.name: SupportsTextureSystemMemory
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device can retrieve textures from system memory.

property.name: SupportsTextureVideoMemory
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device can retrieve textures from device memory.

property.name: SupportsTransformedVertexSystemMemory
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device can use buffers from system memory for transformed and lit vertices.

property.name: SupportsTransformedVertexVideoMemory
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device can use buffers from video memory for transformed and lit vertices.

property.name: VertexElementScanSharesStreamOffset
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device allows multiple vertex elements to share the same offset in a stream.
property.remarks: Multiple vertex elements can share the same offset in a stream if VertexElementScanSharesStreamOffset is true and the vertex declaration does not have an element with VertexElementUsage.PositionTransformed .

method.name: ToString
method.summary: Retrieves a string representation of this object.

overload.summary: Retrieves a string representation of this object.
